import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, LabelEncoder
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import xgboost as xgb
import warnings
import os

test_data = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

    col for col in train_data.columns if col not in ["id", "target", "f_27"]
]

y_train = train_data["target"].copy().astype(float)
X_test_full = test_data[feature_columns].copy()

)

    "f_07",

    "f_15",

]

    X_val[feat] = le[feat].transform(X_val[feat])
    X_test[feat] = le[feat].transform(X_test[feat])

    X_train.iloc[:, X_train.columns.isin(categorical_features) == False]
)

lgb_model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=1000,
    max_depth=-1,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=63,
    min_child_samples=20,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.5,

xgb_model = xgb.XGBClassifier(

    max_depth=7,
    learning_rate=0.05,
